recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-36222; any future workflow-episodeOfCare context corrections should be made in the Extension Pack. Do not treat broader FHIR-26292 as decided here because later context-specific decisions changed parts of that larger list.
issue_request: FHIR-36222 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking that http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/workflow-episodeOfCare support DocumentReference and Flag; the Jira resolution says to add those two resources to the extension context.
initial_application: No core commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-36222 was found. The same context-change family had already been applied through FHIR-26292 and PR #1337 before FHIR-36222 was created: DocumentReference was already present in the old core workflow extension spreadsheet, and commit f5c6a30e broadened the workflow-episodeOfCare context list to include Flag and the other approved resources.
additional_context: Core no longer owns the workflow-episodeOfCare StructureDefinition source. Commit dd468d4f removed extension definitions from the R5 core source, current core source/fhir.ini has no active workflow-episodeOfCare StructureDefinition source, and the current Extension Pack source lists both DocumentReference and Flag. Later FHIR-38721 removed Encounter from the contexts, which does not affect the FHIR-36222 request.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The required contexts are already present in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-workflow-episodeOfCare.xml, so the core combined branch received an empty external-repo audit commit.

related_jiras.note: Earlier broader Published/Persuasive-with-Modification issue that requested DocumentReference and Flag among many additional workflow-episodeOfCare contexts and was applied before FHIR-36222.

Later Applied/Persuasive issue removing Encounter from workflow-episodeOfCare contexts; it explains why the current context list should not be compared mechanically to all FHIR-26292 resolution items.
